name: django-machina-content-mutation-holds
instr:
machina cannot temporarily freeze persisted `DatedModel` content without removing it. Add attributable, persistent mutation holds that moderators can use on any persisted `DatedModel`. Holds may expire or be released, remain inspectable throughout their lifecycle, and protect forums, posts, and polls wherever mutations begin.

An active hold makes its target aggregate immutable. Forum holds also govern dated descendants throughout that forum subtree without affecting unrelated trees. Rejected saves and deletions must be atomic: stored content, relationships, counters, pointers, options, votes, cascades, and other derived effects remain unchanged.

Expiry restores mutability without erasing attribution. Release is attributable and idempotent, and cannot affect another object's hold. State queries distinguish never-held, active, expired, and released objects without attempting mutation. `MutationHold` is a `Model`. `HoldState` is an `Enum`. `MutationHeld` is an `Exception` carrying `obj` and `receipt`. `HoldConflict` is an `Exception` carrying every conflicting `receipts` entry in deterministic order.

Public editing, previews, moderation, and Django administration must turn conflicts into recoverable bound errors, retain submitted data, and expose active hold information. Bulk administrative mutation must validate the complete selection before acting and change nothing if any member conflicts.
